title: Noisy, ambiguous call (no nudges expected)
description: Sales call from a noisy street: traffic hum, horn bursts and background chatter on the customer line, with short non-committal replies. A compliant agent. Good behaviour is to stay quiet.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Priya from Nivaran Health Insurance. This call is recorded for quality purposes. Is this a good time to talk?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello? Hello? Sorry, I'm on the road, it's a bit noisy.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem. I was calling about the health insurance enquiry you made.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah... hmm... I'm not sure. Maybe.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like me to explain the plans briefly?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We have plans for individuals and families, with cashless treatment at network hospitals.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Pre-existing diseases are covered after a waiting period of thirty six months.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, thank you for your time.
